task: Build a Data Engineer AI agent for a trading/investment system: builds data pipelines for market data (ingestion, cleaning, normalization, validation, storage, serving), schema design, migrations, data quality checks, idempotent scheduled ingestion, reproducible dataset versioning
requirement: Data engineer agent: ETL pipelines, market data ingestion, cleaning, normalization, schema design, SQL, data quality, time-series stores
summary: Apply the recommended skills, workflow and tools for building the Data Engineer agent, following the operating loop in agent.md and the data-pipeline-build workflow.

actions: Load the top skills: ml-data-pipeline, data-engineer, sql-schema-design
Connect / install the MCP servers: postgres-mcp, data-studio-agent, clickhouse, dbt-labs-dbt-mcp, airflow-mcp
Use the tools: Airflow, dbt, Pandas, DuckDB
Run the quality gates: schema, idempotency, freshness, counts, validation
Consult the documentation: postgresql-docs, dbt-docs, duckdb-docs

Design the schema with keys/indexes/partitioning (database-design, database-architect, sql-pro, postgresql-optimization)
Implement ingestion + transforms (data-engineer, data-engineering-data-pipeline, ml-feature-engineering, content-hash-cache-pattern)
Run end-to-end, verify gates, write the data dictionary.
cautions: DeepSeek combined ranker was unavailable (MCP timeout); vector rankings used. Re-run get_task_advice when the backend is healthy to refresh advice/.
